nodes.description: Owner address used for access control in lock, unlock, own and releaseFunds
Boolean lock flag guarding the payout in bet()
Payable bet function that pays out 2 ether when a pseudo-random draw wins and msg.value is 1 ether and not locked
Sets locked to true when caller is gameOwner
Sets locked to false when caller is gameOwner
Transfers ownership of gameOwner to owner when unowned or caller is current owner
Sends amount * 1 ether to the caller when caller is gameOwner
View function deriving a pseudo-random uint8 from block.timestamp and block.difficulty
Payable fallback function that forwards to bet()
Caller address, used for authorization checks and as payout recipient
Block timestamp used as a randomness source in random()

edges.reason: bet() executes an external call to msg.sender before the transaction state is settled
The external call in bet() transfers 2 ether to the untrusted msg.sender, enabling reentrant entry via the fallback
locked state variable guards the payout branch of bet()
bet() calls random() to decide whether the bet wins
random() reads block.timestamp as a pseudo-randomness source
random() produces miner-influenceable randomness used for critical game logic
block.timestamp feeds the predictable keccak256-based modulo draw
lock() authorizes the caller by comparing gameOwner with msg.sender
lock() reads gameOwner to perform its authorization check
lock() writes the locked state variable
unlock() authorizes the caller by comparing gameOwner with msg.sender
unlock() reads gameOwner to perform its authorization check
unlock() writes the locked state variable
own() uses msg.sender in the ownership-transfer authorization check
own() reads and writes gameOwner
own() assigns the owner parameter into the gameOwner state variable
releaseFunds() authorizes the caller by comparing gameOwner with msg.sender
releaseFunds() reads gameOwner to perform its authorization check
releaseFunds() performs an external call that forwards ether to the caller
The external call in releaseFunds() sends funds to the untrusted msg.sender, enabling reentrancy
releaseFunds() evaluates amount * (1 ether) before the transfer
The multiplication consumes the amount parameter and can overflow
The payable fallback function forwards execution to bet()

normalization_plan.reason: owner is a non-core parameter consumed only by own(), so it collapses into the own() core function node
amount is a non-core parameter consumed only by releaseFunds(), so it collapses into the releaseFunds() core function node
